title: StructureFacet
description: Containment: package, module, file, namespace, type, function. Attribute schemas are open so plugins can add fields.

buildSystem.description: The build system that declared this package, e.g. bazel, cmake.

callbackSlot.description: On an anonymous function from the TypeScript frontend: true when it is a callback slot (passed to a call directly, or a property of an options bag passed to a call), false for a property arrow of a returned or stored literal (a named member). Absent on a model from an older frontend.

derives.description: Each local the function declares, mapped to the locals it reads. Local names are keyed: a name its function declares once is the bare name; a name declared more than once in one function (shadowing, or the same name in sibling blocks or loops) is `name@line` (1-based line of the declared identifier, `name@line:col` when two share a line). The key is the same everywhere it appears in that function (binds, reads, argReads, derives keys and values, params). Display strips the `@…` suffix.

params.description: The parameter local keys in order.
